data.summary: Senior Project & Change Manager with 18+ years leading enterprise transformation, HR operations, and payroll programs across global, regulated banking environments. raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Senior Project & Change Manager with 18+ years leading enterprise transformation, HR operations, and payroll programs across global, regulated banking environments. Delivered transformation initiatives impacting 1,000+ employees, lifted SLA performance from 85% to 97%, and cut payroll incidents by up to 40% through structured governance and RCA-driven process redesign. Trusted by senior stakeholders to own complex, multi-entity programs end-to-end — from business case through BAU transition — with zero service disruption.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Enterprise Transformation • Change Management • Program & Project Governance • Risk, Audit & Regulatory Compliance • RAID / RACI Frameworks • Stakeholder & Executive Engagement • HR & Payroll Operations • Incident & Root Cause Analysis (RCA) SLA & KPI Management • Agile & Cross-Functional Delivery • ServiceNow HRSD • Process Optimization (Lean / Continuous Improvement)
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Project & Change Manager | Barclays Global Service Centre – Chennai • Directed two enterprise-scale transformation programs (Project Nike & Project Casablanca) spanning HR Operations
Feb 2020 – July 2026
and Payroll, impacting 1,000+ employees across multiple regions and entities.
Decommissioned legacy HR/Payroll mailboxes and migrated 100% of case volume to ServiceNow under Project Nike, lifting SLA performance from 85% to 97% and strengthening audit traceability.
Led Project Casablanca, executing entity integration (Ireland & France SE → Barclays Europe SE) and a cross-border HQ transition (Ireland ↔ Paris) with full regulatory alignment and zero compliance findings.
Owned full project lifecycle — initiation, planning, execution, and closure — across multi-workstream portfolios, consistently delivering within scope, timeline, and budget.
Developed structured change approaches for transformation initiatives, aligning stakeholder engagement, impact assessment, communications, training and implementation activities across workstreams.
Established structured business readiness activities across transformation workstreams, coordinating readiness actions, stakeholder inputs and approvals through implementation and transition to BAU.
Led change impact assessments and stakeholder engagement activities across transformation workstreams, identifying impacts to people, processes and operating practices and translating them into actionable change and readiness activities; achieved 100% adoption with no escalations.
Developed and coordinated stakeholder engagement and communication activities across transformation workstreams, ensuring impacted teams understood changes, required actions and transition expectations. • Built and governed RAID logs, financial trackers, and executive dashboards, giving leadership real-time visibility into risk and enabling proactive mitigation.
Cut payroll-critical incidents by 25–40% by redesigning risk governance and embedding RCA-led preventive controls across the case lifecycle.
Served as global SPOC for change initiatives, partnering with HR Tech, Engineering, and Agile teams to deliver releases with zero business disruption.
Coordinated cross-functional stakeholders across HR Operations, HR Technology, Engineering and Agile teams to support consistent change execution and business adoption.
• Led change impact assessments and stakeholder engagement activities across transformation workstreams,
identifying impacts to people, processes and operating practices and translating them into actionable change and readiness activities; achieved 100% adoption with no escalations.
• Strengthened the operating model with redefined RACI frameworks, improving accountability and cutting decision
turnaround time across project teams.
Managed transition-to-BAU for every program delivered, maintaining zero SLA deviation throughout handover. • Led transition-to-BAU activities across programmes, coordinating operational handover, stakeholder readiness and issue resolution while maintaining zero SLA deviation throughout handover.
Supported post-implementation stabilization and transition to BAU, monitoring operational impacts, resolving emerging issues and maintaining service continuity following change implementation.
Process Expert | Barclays Global Service Centre – Chennai • Validated Right-to-Work and employment documentation for UK operations, maintaining full compliance with UK
Aug 2014 – Feb 2020
Home Office regulations across all audits.
Acted as Escalation Lead for HR and payroll continuity issues, resolving complex cases that protected service delivery during peak-risk periods.Spearheaded process improvements under the Blue Work Program, delivering measurable gains in operational efficiency and compliance scoring.
Owned audit readiness and operational governance, consistently exceeding internal compliance benchmarks.
Process Advisor | Barclays Global Service Centre – Chennai • Managed end-to-end HR operations — onboarding, verification, and employment checks — across UK, APAC,
Nov 2011 – Aug 2014
and India.
Produced management information (MI) reporting that informed performance optimization and capacity planning decisions for senior leadership.
Designed and led training and mentoring programs that lifted team productivity and quality metrics.
Senior Customer Service Executive | Serco BPO – Chennai • Managed an SME collections portfolio, improving recovery and retention rates through targeted account strategies. • Implemented RCA-driven process improvements that reduced outstanding debt and accelerated resolution timelines. • Led regional training sessions that standardized service delivery across multiple locations.
2009 – 2011
Junior Officer | Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) – Chennai • Supported US credit card operations and high-value transaction verification for the Australia region, ensuring
2008 – 2009
data integrity and regulatory compliance.
Resolved escalations and client inquiries with strict adherence to approval protocols and accuracy standards.
TECHNICAL & PLATFORM EXPERTISE
ServiceNow HRSD • Workday • SAP • Salesforce • JIRA • Siebel • Taleo • Microsoft 365 Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI)
